hints: Let x be the number in all three. Write only L and only G in terms of x, then use "ten students in G are in another sport too".
Read "both K and L" as including the students in all three. With the total of 39, that fixes only K. Then L must be bigger than K.
9.why:
Let x be the number in all three. Only L = 2x, only G = 2x − 1. Ten of G's 17 are in another sport, so only G = 7, x = 4 and only L = 8. G's pairs: (G and K only) + (G and L only) = 6.

Only K equals everyone in both K and L (the K-and-L-only group plus the 4 in all three). The total of 39 then gives only K = 9 and K-and-L-only = 5. So K = 18 + (G and K only) and L = 17 + (G and L only).

L > K needs 17 + gl > 18 + (6 − gl), so gl ≥ 4 (gl = 4 gives L 21, K 20). The minimum is 4.

hints: Find how many Old, Middle-aged and Young visitors there were first.
Let e be Old's Gold (which equals Old's Economy) and P the total Platinum. Write every other cell in terms of e and P.

Old = x, Middle = 2x, Young = 4x, so 7x = 140: Old 20, Middle 40, Young 80. Of 55 Economy, Young bought 38, so Old + Middle Economy = 17.

Let P be all Platinum and e be Old's Gold (= Old's Economy). Young: P/2 Platinum, so Young Gold = 80 − 38 − P/2 = 42 − P/2. Old Platinum = 20 − 2e. Old + Middle Platinum = P/2, so Middle Platinum = P/2 − 20 + 2e. Middle Economy = 17 − e, and Middle Gold = 43 − e − P/2.

Old Platinum = Middle Platinum = P/4, and Old Platinum = 20 − 2e is even. So P/4 is even: P = 32 (36 gives 9, which is odd). 32.

hints: Call the base rates 100k, 120k and k. Every amount of L is units × rate, with buying at 0.95 and selling at 1.1 of base.
B's stock didn't change, so B bought as many units as it sold. A's stock went up by 800.
29.why:
Let the base rates be 100k, 120k and k for A, B and C. Buying is at 0.95 × base, selling at 1.1 × base.

A sold: 88000 ÷ 110k = 800/k units. B sales bring in 88000 × 9/5 = 158400, so B sold = 158400 ÷ 132k = 1200/k units. B's stock didn't change, so B bought = 1200/k units, costing 1200/k × 114k = 136800. A purchases cost 136800 × 5/3 = 228000, so A bought = 228000 ÷ 95k = 2400/k units.

A's stock rose by 800: 2400/k − 800/k = 800, so k = 2. Base rates: A 200, B 240, C 2.

A bought = 2400/2 = 1200 units.
